scope_excerpt: ### 6 November · validated noisy H.1 physical-price comparison

[The two-record comparison and physical ledger](https://github.com/gvakhrushev/d0_15/blob/a358e91e764655b16082bf7e6161a79df96a24a6/02_REGISTRY/research/sources/d0_validated_parry_price_2026-11-06/README.md) consume #334 at `191eace4a`. On the same three positive validated outcomes, joint classical surprisal makes the Born-weighted two-token scalar moment constant, while the complete parsed mean has field slope strictly between 5/4 and 4/3 at the original centre. Lean proves the fixed-support identity and the full negative-log price derivative for moving tariffs. Physical Book03 edge cost, vertex Info, work and memory still have to produce a full dual source at the actual gain and right lift. The scoped terminal is withdrawn and `GR_closed=false`.
Latest integrated checkpoint: `a84b870bb`. Concurrent work on the same PR was merged with both histories and implementations preserved.
